topic: Someone finds their childhood teddy bear at a yard sale
text: The worn plush, the faded eyes, the softness that time has barely touched. When the old bear came into my arms, it was like stepping back into a world where the sky was always blue and the days stretched out like the long grass in summer. The scent, though faint, still carried whispers of past hugs and goodnight Stories. I held it close, and all the worries of today felt smaller, distant, like shadows on the edge of a campfire. In this quiet moment, the world seemed to slow, and I found myself smiling, remembering the safety of those early years, the easy joy that needed no explanation.
